s.h: BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
s.t:
At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.
Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you .
We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you.

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.
This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

Change the way the world travels
Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.
Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.
Team mission
Our Talent Acquisition team is the engine behind every great hire at GetYourGuide. We don't just fill roles - we help shape GetYourGuides’ future by finding the people who enable the world to have unforgettable experiences.
We're looking for a Technical Recruiter who will own end-to-end hiring for some of our most critical technical roles. This person will combine deep recruiting expertise with a genuine passion for technology, AI-powered workflows, and operational excellence and will contribute to raising the bar for the entire team along the way.
Please Note: This is a 12 month contract, for Maternity Cover

Own the full recruiting lifecycle for technical roles - from sourcing and shortlisting through interviewing, offer negotiation, and close.
Collaborate closely with the entire Talent Acquisition team to build airtight hiring processes - no detail is too small.
Monitor recruitment dashboards and reports to keep pipeline health in check, surfacing insights and recommendations to hiring teams proactively.
Build and nurture a world-class candidate network through market research, CRM engagement, and genuine relationship management.
Obsess over the candidate experience - gather feedback, analyze survey data, and turn insights into tangible process improvements.
Identify and lead projects that make the TA function smarter and faster - from workflow automation to AI-driven tooling to process redesign.
Mentor and coach fellow team members, share what's working, and train the team on new tools, technologies, and best practices.

Who we are
Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched. Tables run every clinical trial, every financial model, every scientific experiment, every business decision, and no one had built a foundation model that truly understood them.
Until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables. The next modality shift in AI is happening, and we're hiring the team that makes it.
Momentum. We pioneered tabular foundation models and are now the world-leading organization in structured-data ML. Our TabPFN v2 model was published as a Nature cover story and set a new state of the art for tabular machine learning.

Since release we've scaled model capabilities 20x+, passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and are seeing accelerating adoption across research and industry - from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi to improving clinical-trial decisions with BostonGene .
The hardest work is ahead. We're scaling tabular foundation models to millions of rows, thousands of features, real-time inference, and entirely new data modalities, while building the infrastructure to run them in production across some of the most demanding industries on earth. These are open problems no one else is working on at this level.
Our team. We're a small, highly selective team of 30+ engineers, researchers, and GTM specialists, with backgrounds spanning Google, Apple, Amazon, DeepMind, Meta, Microsoft Research, G-Research, Jane Street, Goldman Sachs, and CERN. We're led by Frank Hutter , Noah Hollmann , and Sauraj Gambhir , and advised by world-leading AI researchers including Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun. We ship fast, do top-tier research, and hold each other to an extremely high bar.
What's next. In 2025 we raised €9m pre-seed led by Balderton Capital, backed by leaders from Hugging Face, DeepMind, and Black Forest Labs. The next phase of growth is here, which makes this an ideal time to join.

We're looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to own end-to-end hiring for a portfolio of critical roles across Eight Sleep. Advice Hiring Managers: Partner closely with managers to sharply scope roles, unblock bottlenecks, and drive a seamless interview cadence

Process Optimization: Continuously upgrade recruiting workflows on our ATS (Ashby) to make hiring faster, more scalable, and highly consistent
What You'll Need to Succeed
2–5 years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally in a high-growth startup, D2C, or tech environment
Proven track record sourcing and closing passive candidates, with a deep understanding of how to run a LinkedIn outreach campaign that actually converts
Comfortable recruiting across multiple functions (e.g., marketing, web, mobile) and global regions, quickly learning the nuances of each role to get candidates excited about the company
Sharp judge of talent and culture fit, with strong stakeholder management skills to keep hiring managers aligned and moving
Experience with modern ATS tools (Ashby a plus); organized and metrics-driven in how you track pipeline health
Exceptional communicator, fluent in English

MSC Cruises, the world-s third largest cruise line brand is expanding its Procurement team in the USA. This role monitors delivery status and provides timely updates to stakeholders, while collaborating with the Sourcing, Logistics, Planning and Product teams to ensure the proper execution of the ordering process.

* Follow up with suppliers on deliveries prior to vessel loadings.
* Reconcile invoices and resolve discrepancies related to goods received and payment issues.

* Maintain accurate and current information within the Company-s ERP, Procurement e-Platform and Discrepancy Reports.
* Collaborate with Sourcing, Logistics, Planning, Product and shipboard teams to support efficient ordering and loading operations.

s.h: As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, your role will include
s.t:
Full Cycle Generalist Recruiting: Own the end to end hiring process across Engineering, Product, Go to Market, and corporate roles globally. You will guide candidates from the initial talent screen through offer, adapting your approach to the function and level you are hiring for.
European Market Leadership: Serve as our first EMEA based recruiter and the local face of vCluster Labs for candidates across Europe. s.h: This role could be a fit for you if you bring

About vCluster Labs
We are a venture-backed tech startup and the company pioneering Kubernetes virtualization for the AI era. We raised +$30M from top-tier VCs such as Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, Doordash) and are in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to complement our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe and we have a remote-first work culture.
We are the leading platform for operating GPU infrastructure, enabling AI Cloud providers to deliver a hyperscaler-like experience to their customers and AI factories that need to build that same experience for their internal teams.

Our platform delivers the full operational stack operators need to run their GPU data centers — managed Kubernetes, fast isolated tenant provisioning, and automated node provisioning and lifecycle management — enabling them to accelerate time to value, reduce operational burden, and maximize the ROI of every GPU.
We're the company behind vCluster, an open-source technology for virtualizing Kubernetes (10k+ GitHub stars, 40M+ virtual clusters created since 2021). Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI — a Kubernetes-native framework purpose-built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Culture & Values

s.h: At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for
s.t:

Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.
Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.
Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.
Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

s.h: BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
s.t:
At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.
Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you .
We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you.

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.
This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.
Depending on where you are located, you may have the right to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to opt out of AI-assisted review, to request a manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision.

Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

As a technical recruiter on our R&D team, you will drive full-cycle recruiting for open software engineering roles. In this fast-paced role, you will manage an active load of requisitions, guiding candidates through the hiring process with clarity, speed, and a commitment to quality.
We are looking for someone who is eager to build a career in technical recruiting, highly collaborative, and motivated to learn. You will have access to structured mentorship, supportive leadership, and real-time feedback to help you refine your skills. The candidates who thrive at Samsara are curious, adaptable, and focused on delivering a great experience for candidates and hiring managers alike.
This role is open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

Own full-cycle recruiting: Manage the hiring process for software engineering roles from intake through offer
Execute with efficiency: Keep candidates moving through the process with clear communication, operational discipline, and consistent follow-through
Source proactively: Build diverse candidate pipelines using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, and targeted sourcing strategies
Partner with hiring managers: Run structured intake calls, align on candidate profiles, and maintain transparent communication throughout each search
Deliver an exceptional candidate experience: Represent Samsara with timely updates, clear next steps, and respectful communication at every stage
Use data to improve: Track pipeline metrics to identify bottlenecks and refine your sourcing and screening approach
Apply feedback quickly: Work closely with senior recruiters and managers to continually develop your recruiting skillset
Leverage AI thoughtfully: Use AI-based tools and recruiting technology to streamline repetitive tasks while maintaining a high-touch candidate experience

2-5 years of full-cycle recruiting experience (agency or in-house), with software engineering recruiting experience preferred
Proven ability to manage multiple open requisitions in a fast-paced environment
Strong communication skills with candidates and internal team members
Demonstrated growth mindset with a desire to seek out and act on constructive feedback
Proficiency with sourcing tools, including LinkedIn Recruiter and modern applicant tracking systems
Passion for building a long-term career in technical recruiting
The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders.

Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company.

We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements.

For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements.

Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law.

We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Aujourd'hui, notre bureau genevois a besoin d'un soutien temporaire et c'est pourquoi nous recherchons Consultant\-e en Recrutement pour rejoindre notre équipe pour une période de 4 mois, potentiellement prolongeable.
Notre bureau est un mélange unique de dynamisme, de compétition, d'ambition et de bonne humeur, où chaque membre joue un rôle essentiel. Ce qui nous distingue ? En tant que Consultant\-e en Recrutement, tu seras le chef d'orchestre de tes processus, du recueil du besoin client jusqu'à l'accompagnement de tes candidats en mission. Concrètement, ton quotidien s'articulera autour de ces tâches :
Stratégie \& conseil client : échanger directement avec nos clients (en binôme avec l'Account Manager) pour comprendre leurs besoins. Loin d'être un simple exécutant, tu assumes un rôle d'expert pour les challenger et les orienter vers la meilleure stratégie d'acquisition.
Copywriting \& attraction : rédiger des annonces immersives, transparentes et ciblées. Fini le jargon purement corporate : tu parles le langage de nos candidats pour te démarquer et attirer les meilleurs talents.

Tu deviendras un\-e expert\-e dans l'analyse de nos tests psychométriques et cognitifs pour identifier le vrai potentiel au\-delà du simple CV.

Tu utiliseras les données scientifiques de tes évaluations comme un levier pour convaincre tes clients de miser sur le potentiel, tout en menant les négociations (salariales, conditions) d'une main de maître.
Onboarding \& partenariat : Garantir un suivi administratif irréprochable (contrats, permis, certificats, etc.). Sur le terrain, tu deviens le career partner de tes consultants, avec ce qu'il faut de fermeté et de bienveillance pour maintenir des relations durables.

## Description de l'entreprise ##
Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. Pour en savoir plus sur notre institution, prenez quelques minutes pour découvrir les moments forts de l-année 2025 en cliquant ici.
La Direction des ressources humaines a pour principale mission d-assurer le développement du capital humain de l-institution en perspective de l-évolution organisationnelle. Elle recherche constamment à innover, challenger et améliorer ses pratiques tout en basant sa stratégie sur l-expérience positive des collaborateurs et collaboratrices.

La politique RH des HUG se fonde sur le développement des compétences et des parcours professionnels en adéquation avec les besoins institutionnels et se concentre sur la prise en compte de la personne, de l-équilibre vie professionnelle/vie privée et de la santé et sécurité au travail.
## Description du poste ##
Reportant au responsable de programme Qualité de vie au travail, vous rejoignez la Direction des ressources humaines et participez activement à la mise en œuvre de la « stratégie RH 2023-2028 ».
Intégré ou intégrée à l-équipe en poste, vous participez à la mise en œuvre des initiatives visant à favoriser les présences et à gérer les absences. Vous contribuez, au travers de l-analyse des données, à mieux comprendre les déterminants de l-absence et les pistes d-actions possibles. Avec le support d-un ou une statisticienne, vous contribuez à l-établissement de tableaux de bords, clés en mains, directement utiles aux managers de proximité et à l-ensemble de la fonction RH et partenaires.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

As a SpaceX recruiter, you will run a full desk with a variety of duties and responsibilities focused on the sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding of top talent candidates to fill mission critical positions (pun intended).

In many cases, you are candidates’ first encounter with SpaceX and it is your job to represent the company with professionalism, pride, and enthusiasm. We work in teams and focus on collaboration yet require a high degree of autonomy.

So while you are not expected to simply go it alone, you are expected to show initiative, take responsibility, and run with tasks to completion.
Your day-to-day routine will change often as hiring priorities shift, but there is a basic set of activities you can expect to run with daily, including, but not limited to:
Meet with your client groups to discuss headcount, new requisitions, hiring strategy, and/or interview feedback – you truly act as a partner to your clients and not merely as an order taker
Screen candidates who apply to requisitions – as the SpaceX name brand grows, our job postings continue to fill up with stellar candidates
Source candidates – often the best candidates are the ones not actively looking
Discuss candidates you have screened with your client groups and recommend top candidates for interviews
Give tours to candidates before their onsite interview – this is a chance to showcase all the exciting things going on at SpaceX
Attend interviews alongside your client groups to act as another set of eyes and ears in evaluating candidates
Once candidates are approved for hire, you will begin the HR onboarding process including initiating background checks, completing reference checks, negotiating offer packages including extending offer letters, and issuing new hire paperwork – you’ll have plenty of support from the HR, benefits, and compensation departments to make this process as seamless as possible
Some days you will have multiple candidates coming onsite for interviews and you will spend that time giving tours and coordinating the candidate experience. Other days, you will need to fill your candidate pipeline and will spend the majority of the day screening/sourcing candidates. No day is the same here and the pace moves fast, but ultimately your job is to effectively attract, organize, and manage the flow of the country’s most talented individuals to help advance the mission to Mars!

Son ambition est d'être une institution de santé dynamique, novatrice et visant l'excellence au profit de la population Broyarde. Pour relever les nombreux défis qui l'attendent, l'HIB est à la recherche d'un.e :
**Gestionnaire en ressources humaines à 100% (Salaires et assurances sociales)**
### Votre mission ###
Assurer la gestion opérationnelle des assurances sociales, des absences et des processus liés à la paie, en garantissant la fiabilité des données, la conformité légale et réglementaire ainsi que la sécurisation des enjeux financiers de l'établissement. Contribuer activement à l'amélioration continue des processus RH et à la qualité des données administratives et salariales.
**Gestion des assurances sociales**
* Gérer les dossiers d'incapacité de travail (maladie, accident, maternité etc.), de l'ouverture à leur clôture.
* Déclarer et suivre les indemnités journalières, les allocations pour perte de gain et les allocations familiales, en garantissant leur correcte intégration dans la paie.
* Assurer le suivi administratif des absences de longue durée en collaboration avec les responsables hiérarchiques et les assureurs.
* Contrôler les remboursements des assurances sociales et leur concordance avec les prestations versées.
* Assurer les relations avec les différents partenaires des assurances sociales.
**Gestion des salaires**
* Intégrer et contrôler les éléments variables de salaire en lien avec les assurances sociales et les absences.
* Assurer le suivi, le contrôle et la validation des notes de frais des collaborateurs, conformément aux directives internes.
* Assurer le processus mensuel de paie et effectuer les contrôles nécessaires avant validation.
* Garantir l'application correcte de l'impôt à la source.
* Établir, contrôler et valider les factures liées aux assurances sociales.
* Participer au bouclement mensuel des salaires et garantir la fiabilité des données de paie.
* Contrôler et justifier les éléments constitutifs des salaires ainsi que leur imputation comptable.
* Participer aux clôtures annuelles, aux déclarations réglementaires et à l'établissement des certificats de salaire.
**Gestion des temps et des absences**
* Assurer le suivi des certificats médicaux et la saisie dans le système de gestion des temps.
* Assurer le bouclement mensuel du système de gestion des temps, contrôler les indicateurs et garantir la régularisation des anomalies.
* Garantir la cohérence des données entre le système de gestion des temps, le logiciel de paie et les assurances sociales.
* Accompagner les responsables dans la gestion des anomalies liées aux absences et au temps de travail.
### Vos atouts ###
* Brevet fédéral de spécialiste en ressources humaines ou formation jugée équivalente.
* Expérience confirmée d-au moins 5 ans dans le traitement des salaires, les assurances sociales et l-administration RH, idéalement au sein d-une organisation de taille comparable.
* Excellente maîtrise des assurances sociales suisses, des processus de paie et des dispositions légales applicables.
* Solides compétences analytiques et intérêt marqué pour les chiffres, les contrôles et la fiabilité des données.
* Maîtrise des outils informatiques usuels. la connaissance d-Opale bluePearl et de Polypoint, un atout.
* Personne autonome, rigoureuse et organisée, capable de gérer les priorités et d'assurer un haut niveau de qualité.

Building the Future of Open Finance
Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

Our Global Sourcing team is looking for an exceptional Sourcer to help build the future of global finance at Payward. This is a high-bar role requiring extreme ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate complex hiring challenges in a fully remote, high-agency, async-first environment where speed and quality are the standard.
Main differentiators between this role and any other Sourcer role on the market:
Managing uncertainty : Payward is at the forefront of the innovation spectrum. As such, you can expect to tackle roles that you have never heard about, with no prior experience, data or track record
Subject matter expertise: We are building one interoperable stack connecting crypto, tokenized assets, and traditional markets. We are looking for experts in the fintech field, or deep thinkers able to bridge that gap quickly
Pace: You will be expected to flex your sourcing skills across Tech, Non-tech and anything in between with a very quick turnaround, across different payzones and businesses under the Payward umbrella, including Kraken, Ninjatrader and Reap.
Builder mentality : We are not looking for a plain executioner but someone that will contribute to building something new, awesome and cutting edge
Team work : Our sourcing team’s track record is unprecedented - we provide velocity and quality to our pipelines through hard work, but always working as a team. We have no room for solo players or internal competition
In return, we offer the chance to leave a mark in one of the most innovative companies in the space as well as the opportunity to join a world-class and high-performance team. If you believe you have what it takes, continue reading below.
The opportunity
Partner with Hiring Managers and Recruiters to design and execute effective hiring strategies
Gather, organise and communicate competitive market intelligence, identifying where target talent exists and sharing industry trends
Collaborate with the broader sourcing team in leveraging best practices across research techniques, boolean searches, tools, networking and other sourcing methods
Independently develop and maintain candidate flow across a variety of disciplines, leveraging data to drive decision making and process improvement
Source candidates through a variety of search resources (social media, internal database, job boards, networking, internet searches, etc.)
Be an ambassador to Kraken/Payward, sharing our values and drive brand awareness in the market
Participate in research projects and other initiatives which improve the infrastructure of hiring

Exceptional track record sourcing talent for reputable, fast-growing, high bar technology/product businesses against ruthless competition. Bonus points if you’ve hacked it in crypto, fintech or any product-driven org
High craft - Ability to translate hiring needs into accurate sourcing strategies; strong expertise in boolean/X-ray sourcing
High motor
Scrappiness - you do not see problems but opportunities
Strong product sense
Sound appreciation for the fundamentals of talent acquisition, but creative and inquisitive when considering modern tactics
High agency, strong bias for action, and the confidence to push boundaries, influence stakeholders, and close exceptional talent without compromise.
Comfort in the chaos, thriving in ambiguity, owning your outcomes, and moving with urgency in a fully async, remote-native setting
Ability to produce compelling market intelligence based on business and industry knowledge - Fintech/crypto understanding required.

Our commitment
Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. TL;DR: We’re looking for an AI Research Recruiter who knows where exceptional AI Researchers and engineers can be found. You’ll own full-cycle hiring across research, machine learning, data, evaluations, and ML infrastructure, helping us build one of the strongest teams in AI safety.

White Circle is an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems. At the core of our platform are policies – simple natural-language rules that define what an AI model should and shouldn’t do. We automatically test, enforce, and continuously improve these policies at scale.
We’ve raised $11M from top funds, founders, and senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepMind, Datadog, Sentry, and others
We process over one hundred million API calls every month
We fine-tune and train our own LLMs so they run faster and cheaper than any open or proprietary model
We’re a small, highly focused team. If you want to work deeply on hard problems, see your work ship to production quickly, and influence how AI safety is actually built – you’re the one we need.

Partner closely with research leadership and CEO to define highly specialised candidate profiles
Source talent from AI labs, research organisations, technical startups, universities, open-source communities, and relevant scientific networks
Understand the differences between Research Scientists, Research Engineers, Applied ML Engineers, and ML infra Engineers & assess candidates accordingly
Evaluate candidates’ actual contributions
Engage researchers and engineers who are not actively looking for a new role and communicate why White Circle’s problems are technically meaningful
Follow developments in AI safety, model behavior, evaluations, multimodal systems, agentic systems, data quality, post-training, and ML infrastructure
Design structured hiring processes that assess research depth, engineering ability, originality, and real-world impact
Deliver an exceptional candidate experience, including for candidates navigating multiple highly competitive opportunities
Track recruiting performance and continuously improve sourcing strategies, processes, tools, and workflows
Support hiring outside your primary stream when business priorities require it

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.
Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor . Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps.

Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

You will partner closely with our Talent Team to develop a deep understanding of our hiring needs, challenges, organizational structure, and individual team dynamics.

In this role, you will own full-cycle recruitment—from sourcing and engaging passive and active talent globally, to guiding candidates through our end-to-end hiring process, to generating offers and transitioning new hires to our People Ops Specialist for onboarding.

You will act as a key internal stakeholder, collaborating across teams to manage headcount reconciliation, oversee compensation alignment and equity, and coordinate and participate in internal interviews. You will also be responsible for ensuring recruitment projects are delivered on time and that all milestones and deliverables are met.

This role requires exceptional administrative strength , including the ability to navigate multiple documents and systems while adhering to structured, process-driven workflows.

Own and execute the Greenhouse recruiting process end-to-end, managing roles from opening through close while ensuring full process adherence.

Provide timely, clear, and proactive updates to hiring managers and business stakeholders, anticipating needs and addressing issues before they arise.
Operate with a proactive mindset, staying one step ahead of recruiting workflows to prevent bottlenecks and ensure a smooth, efficient hiring experience.
Sourcing is a primary part of your role. You are confident in engaging passive candidates and utilizing the team’s networks to engage with candidates appropriately.

Vous souhaitez exercer le métier de recruteur dans un environnement où la technologie, la qualité de la relation humaine et la connaissance du marché sont au cœur du métier ?
Rejoignez Sigmalis Talent Services et participez au développement d’un groupe suisse à taille humaine, spécialisé dans les métiers de l’informatique.
Le groupe Sigmalis
Présent en Suisse romande depuis 2007, Sigmalis réunit aujourd’hui deux structures complémentaires autour d’une même ambition : accompagner durablement les entreprises dans leurs projets informatiques.
Sigmalis, ESN basée à Genève, accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets informatiques grâce à ses expertises en développement applicatif, Business Intelligence et Data Management. Ses consultants interviennent aussi bien en mission directement au sein des équipes clients que dans le cadre de projets réalisés au forfait.
Sigmalis Talent Services, société sœur spécialisée dans le recrutement IT, accompagne les entreprises dans la recherche et la sélection de profils informatiques, dans le cadre de recrutements fixes ou de missions temporaires.
Cette complémentarité nous permet de conjuguer connaissance des métiers IT, expertise du recrutement et proximité avec le marché suisse romand.
Description du poste
Votre mission En tant que Consultant·e en recrutement IT, vous prenez en charge l'ensemble du processus de recrutement, depuis la compréhension du besoin jusqu'au suivi des candidats.

Vous intervenez aussi bien sur les recrutements destinés à renforcer les équipes de consultants du groupe que sur les mandats confiés à Sigmalis Talent Services par ses clients.

Votre rôle ne consiste pas uniquement à identifier des CV : vous cherchez à comprendre les parcours, les compétences, les motivations et les aspirations professionnelles afin de créer des mises en relation pertinentes et durables.

Vos principales responsabilités Comprendre les besoins de recrutement, les environnements techniques et les profils recherchés, Définir et déployer les stratégies de sourcing et d'approche directe les plus adaptées, Rédiger et publier des offres d'emploi attractives et ciblées, Identifier et approcher des candidats via les différents outils, réseaux professionnels et techniques de chasse de tête, Analyser les candidatures et évaluer leur adéquation avec les exigences techniques, professionnelles et humaines du poste, Préparer et conduire des entretiens approfondis et structurés, Rédiger des comptes rendus d'entretien précis permettant de restituer les compétences, l'expérience, les motivations et les éléments déterminants de chaque candidature, Accompagner les candidats tout au long du processus et assurer un suivi régulier et professionnel, Garantir la qualité et la mise à jour des informations dans notre ATS et constituer des viviers de talents sur les profils régulièrement recherchés, Développer une relation de proximité avec les équipes internes du groupe et comprendre leurs besoins actuels et futurs, Contribuer à l'attractivité de nos opportunités et à notre marque employeu
Profil recherché
Vous bénéficiez de 2 à 5 ans d'expérience dans le recrutement et le sourcing de profils IT au sein d'une agence de recrutement ou d'une société de services informatiques en Suisse romande. Cette connaissance du marché local est importante pour vous permettre d'être rapidement autonome dans votre fonction.

Vous disposez également des compétences et qualités suivantes : excellente maîtrise des méthodes de sourcing, de recherche directe et de chasse de tête, bonne connaissance des principaux métiers et environnements de l'informatique, connaissance du marché de l'emploi et du tissu économique de Suisse romande, capacité à conduire des entretiens structurés et à évaluer une candidature au\-delà des seuls éléments du CV, français langue maternelle ou niveau équivalent, avec d'excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et une orthographe irréprochable, bon niveau d'anglais vous permettant de conduire des entretiens avec des candidats anglophones, sens de l'organisation, rigueur et capacité à gérer plusieurs recrutements et priorités simultanément, excellentes qualités relationnelles et sens de la communication, autonomie, proactivité et orientation résultats, goût du travail en équipe et capacité à collaborer avec différents interlocuteurs et métiers, respect absolu de la confidentialité et de l'éthique inhérentes au métier du recrutement.

Nous recherchons une personne qui souhaite s'investir dans la durée, développer son expertise et contribuer activement à la croissance de notre activité. Rejoindre Sigmalis Talent Services, c'est… Intégrer un groupe suisse à taille humaine, dans lequel les échanges sont directs et les responsabilités réelles.

Exercer pleinement votre métier de recruteur, de l'analyse du besoin à l'accompagnement du candidat, avec une attention particulière portée à la qualité des recrutements. Évoluer au contact de spécialistes de l'IT, qui permettent de mieux comprendre les métiers, les environnements techniques et les enjeux rencontrés par nos clients.

Construire des relations de proximité avec les candidats, en privilégiant la qualité des échanges et du suivi plutôt qu'une approche purement quantitative du recrutement. Travailler sur des missions variées, aussi bien pour les besoins internes du groupe que pour des entreprises et organisations de Suisse romande.

Participer au développement d'une structure en croissance, dans laquelle vos idées, votre expérience et votre capacité à prendre des initiatives pourront directement contribuer à faire évoluer nos pratiques.

Enfin, nous accordons une importance particulière à l'éthique, la confidentialité, la qualité du travail réalisé et au respect des engagements pris envers nos candidats comme envers nos clients. Vous vous reconnaissez dans cette approche du recrutement et souhaitez poursuivre votre parcours dans un environnement spécialisé IT ?

With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions.

Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost.

We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

You will partner closely with our Talent Team to develop a deep understanding of our hiring needs, challenges, organizational structure, and individual team dynamics.

In this role, you will own full-cycle recruitment—from sourcing and engaging passive and active talent globally, to guiding candidates through our end-to-end hiring process, to generating offers and transitioning new hires to our People Ops Specialist for onboarding.

You will act as a key internal stakeholder, collaborating across teams to manage headcount reconciliation, oversee compensation alignment and equity, and coordinate and participate in internal interviews. You will also be responsible for ensuring recruitment projects are delivered on time and that all milestones and deliverables are met.

This role requires exceptional administrative strength , including the ability to navigate multiple documents and systems while adhering to structured, process-driven workflows.

Own and execute the Greenhouse recruiting process end-to-end, managing roles from opening through close while ensuring full process adherence.
Maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date hiring documentation , tracking all candidate and hire data to support seamless reporting, audits, and data-driven decision-making.
Demonstrate exceptional organizational skills , effectively managing multiple roles, priorities, and deadlines while maintaining attention to detail throughout the day.
Provide timely, clear, and proactive updates to hiring managers and business stakeholders, anticipating needs and addressing issues before they arise.
Operate with a proactive mindset, staying one step ahead of recruiting workflows to prevent bottlenecks and ensure a smooth, efficient hiring experience.
Sourcing is a primary part of your role. You are confident in engaging passive candidates and utilizing the team’s networks to engage with candidates appropriately.

Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. We are on a mission to acquire, build, and grow great companies worldwide, helping them modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline.

The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world. Banyan is Great Place to Work Certified, a five-time Inc. 5000 honoree, and a top 10 company on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500.

Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Atlanta, Banyan operates more than 100 portfolio companies across North America, the UK, EU, and APAC.
Principal Recruiter: Europe (Hybrid)
We’re building a portfolio of exceptional software businesses across the globe. As our European presence continues to expand through acquisitions and organic growth, we’re looking for a seasoned Principal Recruiter to independently lead and execute hiring across all levels, including executive search, across our portfolio companies and headquarters throughout Europe.
This is a highly visible, high-impact role where you’ll operate as a strategic talent partner to CEOs, senior executives, and business leaders. You’ll own searches end-to-end: scoping roles, mapping markets, engaging candidates, and closing hires without needing day-to-day guidance. Beyond individual searches, you’ll help shape how we approach talent across a growing, multi-country portfolio, bringing structure, best practices, and market intelligence that raises the bar for the entire function.
If you thrive on working autonomously, building trusted relationships with senior leaders, and solving complex hiring challenges across geographies, this is an opportunity to influence growth at both a regional and global level.

Own and execute recruitment across all levels independently. Lead full-cycle hiring from intake through close, including executive-level searches (C-suite, VP, Managing Director, and other key leadership positions) across our growing European portfolio. You’ll manage your own requisition load, prioritize competing demands, and drive results with minimal oversight.
Build proactive, long-term talent pipelines. Continuously map talent landscapes across multiple European markets, identify emerging leaders, and cultivate relationships with high-caliber professionals well before hiring needs arise.
Serve as a trusted talent advisor to senior leaders. Partner directly with CEOs, executives, and leadership teams on talent market trends, organizational design, succession planning, and leadership hiring strategy. You’ll bring a point of view grounded in data and market intelligence, not just fill open roles.
Bring structure and rigor to how we hire. Design and implement best-in-class recruiting processes that can be leveraged across portfolio companies, ensuring a consistent, high-quality hiring experience regardless of geography or business unit.
Leverage data and competitive intelligence. Use market knowledge, compensation benchmarking, and talent analytics to inform hiring decisions and executive search strategies across diverse European geographies.
Connect talent strategy to business outcomes. Work at the intersection of talent and business strategy, helping portfolio companies secure the leaders and key contributors they need to execute growth plans, drive transformation, and maximize long-term value creation.
Elevate the broader recruiting function. Share expertise, mentor less experienced team members, and contribute to the development of scalable recruiting playbooks, tools, and standards across the organization.

Extensive recruiting experience, with deep expertise in executive search, leadership hiring, and senior-level talent acquisition. You’ve led complex, high-stakes searches and closed senior hires in competitive markets.
Proven ability to manage a complex full requisition load independently.
Experience recruiting across multiple European markets with an understanding of diverse talent landscapes, cultures, labor regulations, and hiring environments.
A track record of building and maintaining proactive executive talent pipelines in fast-paced, high-growth, or multi-business environments.
Strong business acumen. You connect talent strategy to organizational growth objectives and can speak the language of the business leaders you support.
Credibility with senior stakeholders. You’ve earned the trust of executives, CEOs, and board-level leaders through data, market intelligence, and strategic insight, not just speed of delivery.
A strategic mindset paired with hands-on execution. You’re equally comfortable advising on org design as you are sourcing a niche candidate in a new market.
In-house executive recruiting experience preferred. Agency or search firm backgrounds are valued, but you should understand the dynamics of partnering with internal stakeholders over time and building long-term relationships inside a growing organization.

Jobbeschreibung
Personalberater – Recruiting & Kundenbetreuung (m/w/d)
Du willst Unternehmen wirklich beraten statt nur Profile weiterzureichen – und dabei sehen, was dein Einsatz am Monatsende wert ist? Dann passt das hier.
Beratung und Umsetzung laufen in unserer Branche meist getrennt: Die einen verkaufen, die anderen besetzen, und keiner trägt das Ergebnis ganz. Wir machen es anders. In dieser Position begleitest du deine Kunden von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zur besetzten Stelle. Du weißt genau, was du versprochen hast – weil du es anschließend selbst einlöst.
Hinter dem Ganzen steht Aramaz Digital, eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung mit Sitz in der Bielefelder Innenstadt. Wir machen Unternehmen als Arbeitgeber sichtbar und liefern ihnen kalkulierbar passende Bewerbungen – auf Basis von Daten, nicht von Bauchgefühl. Fachkräftemangel und demografischer Wandel sorgen dafür, dass unser Markt Jahr für Jahr größer wird.
Dein Aufgabengebiet
Kundenbetreuung und Neugeschäft
Du sprichst Unternehmen aktiv an – am Telefon und über Direktkontakte – und weckst Interesse an unseren digitalen Recruiting-Lösungen.
Im Gespräch findest du heraus, woran die Personalgewinnung tatsächlich hakt, und leitest daraus einen konkreten Vorschlag ab.
Du stellst dein Konzept überzeugend vor, verhandelst und bringst den Auftrag zum Abschluss.
Nach dem Start bleibst du fester Ansprechpartner deiner Kunden und baust die Zusammenarbeit weiter aus.
Recruiting und Projektsteuerung
Du planst die Kampagne, steuerst ihre Laufzeit und passt sie an, wenn die Zahlen es verlangen.
Du sichtest Bewerbungen, führst erste Gespräche zur Vorauswahl und sorgst dafür, dass Kandidaten den Prozess positiv erleben.
Bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung behältst du das Projekt in der Hand.
Organisation im Hintergrund
Du hältst deine Aktivitäten im CRM nach, kennst den Stand deiner Pipeline und arbeitest auf klar messbare Ziele hin.
Mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung stimmst du dich eng ab und bringst Ideen ein, wie wir unsere Abläufe schärfen können.
Das erwarten wir von dir
Freude an Akquise: Die aktive Kundenansprache ist für dich kein notwendiges Übel, sondern der Teil, der dich reizt.
Beraterisches Denken: Du stellst die Fragen, die den Kern treffen, erkennst Zusammenhänge und erklärst deine Lösung nachvollziehbar.
Blick für beide Seiten: Du verstehst, was Personalverantwortliche umtreibt – und was Bewerber überzeugt.
Eigener Antrieb: Du strukturierst deinen Tag selbst, steckst Absagen weg und willst mehr erreichen als das Nötigste.
Dein Werdegang ist zweitrangig: Studium, Ausbildung oder Quereinstieg aus dem Verkauf – entscheidend ist, was du willst, nicht was auf dem Papier steht. Erfahrung im Recruiting nehmen wir gerne mit, voraussetzen tun wir sie nicht.
Das bekommst du dafür
Vergütung nach oben offen: Festgehalt als sichere Basis, dazu eine Provision ohne Deckelung.
Unbefristet ab dem ersten Tag: Wir planen langfristig mit dir, in einem Markt, der stabil wächst.
Zwei Kompetenzfelder gleichzeitig: Beratung und Personalgewinnung – eine Kombination, die dir jede Tür offen hält. Der Entwicklungsweg ist klar: Recruiter, Junior Consultant, Senior Consultant.
Begleitete Einarbeitung: Strukturiertes Onboarding, Trainings zu Akquise, Beratung und Besetzung, dazu regelmäßige Feedbackrunden.
Arbeitsplatz auf hohem Niveau: Höhenverstellbare Tische, Herman-Miller-Stühle, Apple-Hardware – zentral gelegen in Bielefeld.
Fitness auf uns: Premium-Mitgliedschaft im Studio deiner Wahl.
Gut versorgt im Büro: Siebträgermaschine mit Julius-Meinl-Kaffee, ausgesuchte Tees, flexibles Mittagsangebot über Meyer Menü.
Flache Hierarchie: Leistungsorientiert und trotzdem kollegial, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung.
Der Bewerbungsweg
Ohne Anschreiben bewerben – der Lebenslauf genügt, zwei Minuten reichen.
Telefonat zum Kennenlernen – Rückmeldung von uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden.
Gespräch vor Ort in unserem Büro in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.
Wenn du deinen nächsten Schritt selbst bestimmen willst: Wir freuen uns auf dich.

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We are looking for a Global Recruiter to support hiring across multiple functions and regions as BJAK continues to scale globally.

Coordinate and manage interview processes while ensuring a positive candidate experience.
Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment activities within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
Provide regular hiring updates and pipeline insights to hiring managers and stakeholders.
Support recruitment process improvements, hiring initiatives, and employer branding activities where required.
Collaborate with recruiters, coordinators, and business leaders to achieve hiring goals across the organization.

2–5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, Executive Search, Staffing, or a related field.

Strong sourcing capabilities across LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, networking, and direct outreach.
Experience recruiting across multiple functions such as Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Product, Engineering, or other corporate functions.
Strong candidate assessment and interviewing skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Highly organized with strong attention to detail and execution.
Comfortable operating in an environment with evolving priorities and ambitious hiring goals.
Demonstrates ownership, resilience, adaptability, and a proactive mindset.
Experience in technology companies, startups, recruitment agencies, or high-growth organizations is highly preferred.
Fluency in English is required. Additional language capabilities such as Mandarin, Bahasa Indonesia, Thai, or Japanese are an advantage.
What Success Looks Like
Delivers strong candidate pipelines across multiple functions and markets.
Consistently achieves hiring targets while maintaining quality and candidate experience.
Builds trusted relationships with hiring managers and stakeholders.
Demonstrates strong ownership and accountability throughout the recruitment process.
Contributes to improving recruitment efficiency, hiring quality, and overall team performance.

Above-market remuneration.
Fast-track career growth and development opportunities.
Exposure to international hiring across multiple markets and functions.
Opportunity to work directly with experienced recruiters and business leaders.

About A1
There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.
Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.
Role
You will support end-to-end recruiting for A1’s product, engineering, and business roles.
This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. You will work closely with recruiters and hiring managers to keep hiring moving smoothly and accurately. It’s a good fit for someone early in their career who wants to learn how high-quality technical hiring actually works in practice.
What you will be doing
Support the full recruitment process across roles, from sourcing and screening to interview coordination and offer support.
Source candidates through a mix of channels, including LinkedIn, referrals, job boards, and proactive outreach.
Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate screens to assess basic role fit, motivation, and communication.
Coordinate interviews, scheduling, and feedback collection with candidates and hiring managers.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate records in the ATS, ensuring data quality and process consistency.
Support recruiting projects and process improvements as the team scales, including candidate experience and employer branding initiatives.
Help keep hiring operations organised, responsive, and moving at pace.
What you will need
0–2 years of experience in recruiting, HR, operations, coordination, or related roles
(fresh graduates with a strong interest in recruiting are welcome).
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
Clear written and verbal communication skills.
Comfort working with tools such as Google Sheets / Excel and basic ATS systems.
A proactive, learning-oriented mindset and openness to feedback.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and follow through reliably.
(Prior recruiting experience is helpful but not required. Attitude, curiosity, and execution matter more.)

Learn technical recruiting from the ground up in a small, high-bar team.
Work closely with experienced recruiters, engineers, and hiring managers.

Flat structure where initiative and execution matter more than titles.
Clear growth path into Talent Partner, Recruiter, or specialised technical hiring roles.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.
We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

## Job Description ##
As (Senior) Talent Acquisition Specialist you will be responsible for attracting and hiring talents across Europe, with main focus on DACH region while supporting selected global recruitment projects. You will own the full recruitment lifecycle, partnering closely with hiring managers and business leaders, as well HR Business Partners to understand business needs, develop effective hiring strategies, and deliver best candidate experience.

* **End-to-End Recruitment:**
Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for positions across Europe, with focus on DACH region, while supporting selected global recruitment projects.
Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, define recruitment strategies, and ensure timely, high-quality hiring outcomes.
Lead intake meetings, develop sourcing strategies, conduct interviews, coordinate interview processes, manage offers, and support onboarding activities.
Ensure a positive and professional candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
* **Talent Sourcing & Attraction**
Proactively identify, engage, and attract high-quality talent through direct sourcing, LinkedIn Recruiter, networking, referrals, and other sourcing channels.
Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
Develop innovative sourcing strategies for difficult-to-fill positions.
* **Stakeholder Management**
Act as a trusted recruitment partner to hiring managers and HR Business Partners.
Facilitate hiring decisions by ensuring a structured and objective assessment process.
* **Recruitment Administration & Reporting**
Manage recruitment activities within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
Ensure recruitment documentation is accurate and compliant with company policies and local labor legislation.
Track recruitment KPIs and provide regular reporting on hiring activities and recruitment performance.
You will support and contribute to another HR projects as well!

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition or Recruitment, preferably within an international and matrixed organization.
* Demonstrated expertise in end-to-end recruitment, including sourcing strategies, competency-based interviewing, candidate assessment, and selection methodologies.
* Strong knowledge of modern recruitment tools, sourcing techniques, and applicant tracking systems (ATS), with the ability to leverage recruitment data and metrics to drive continuous improvement and informed decision-making.
* Proven experience partnering with business leaders and hiring managers, providing strategic talent acquisition guidance in a complex, multinational environment.
* Experience in developing and executing employer branding initiatives and talent attraction strategies across multiple channels.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple recruitment projects simultaneously while maintaining a high level of quality and candidate experience.
* Fluent in both German and English; additional language skills are considered an asset.

This is a fixed-term contract role supporting Prosci 's Talent Acquisition function across the US and Canada. The Sr. Contract Recruiter owns full life cycle recruiting for an assigned slate of open requisitions, from intake through offer, partnering closely with hiring managers and HR Business Partners to build strong candidate pipelines and a consistently positive candidate experience.
This role is intended to add recruiting capacity for a period of approximately 6 months (September 2026 – February 2027) with an anticipated workload of 20–40 hours per week; volume will vary with interview activity and open requisition load.
Since our founding in 1994, Prosci has been laser-focused on change. By combining our deep understanding of people with a proven methodology rooted in the creation of the ADKAR® model, we’ve helped countless people and organizations thrive. Our solutions empower customers with lasting change resiliency through a unique blend of training, advisory services, and licensing options, including Kaiya, our AI change management coach.
At Prosci , we are a purpose-driven organization full of passionate, curious, and results-oriented people. Working at Prosci means being part of a dynamic team that is dedicated to our purpose of creating a world where change is done right. Join us and be part of a culture that thrives on continuous learning, growth, and making a difference.
Check out our website for more about our team and approach: .

Recruiting
Manage full life cycle recruiting for assigned US and Canadian requisitions: intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, assessment administration, reference and background checks, and offer support.
Lead intake and needs analysis conversations with hiring managers to confirm role scope, must-have criteria, and hiring timeline before opening a requisition.
Partner with HRBPs to create and publish job descriptions and postings.
Source active and passive candidates using Prosci 's ATS (Workable), LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, employee referrals, and other channels.
Conduct phone screens, coordinate interview loops, administer assessments, and lead scorecard completion and debrief discussions with interview teams.
Maintain regular, high-quality communication with candidates throughout the process to protect the candidate’s experience.
Support offer construction and, in partnership with the hiring HRBP and hiring manager, help negotiate terms with candidates.
Pipeline, Compliance, and Candidate Experience
Build and maintain candidate pipelines for roles that recur or are historically difficult to fill.
Apply sourcing, screening, and interview practices consistent with Prosci 's commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, including attention to underexplored talent pools.
Apply working knowledge of US and Canadian hiring requirements relevant to recruiting (for example, pay transparency rules, background check requirements, and state or provincial variation) and flag questions to HR Business Partners rather than making independent compliance calls.
Perform select preboarding activities for new hires from the point of offer acceptance to start date, including internal stakeholder communication, coordination of first day logistics, and scheduling of week 1 core onboarding sessions.
Reporting and Process
Keep candidate and requisition records current and accurate in the ATS (Workable).
Provide regular pipeline and hiring status updates to hiring managers and HR Business Partners.
Flag process friction or candidate experience issues to HR Business Partners and suggest improvements.

Full life cycle recruiting experience across sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer support, ideally spanning both US and Canadian hiring. Working knowledge of US and Canadian employment and hiring practices, with good judgment about when to escalate a compliance question (only US is required).
Working proficiency with an applicant tracking system and with LinkedIn Recruiter or an equivalent sourcing tool.
Strong written and verbal communication, comfortable managing multiple candidates, requisitions, and hiring manager relationships at once.
Ability to work independently against a defined requisition load with minimal day-to-day oversight.
Comfort using AI tools across the recruiting life cycle, primarily to synthesize interview notes and scorecard feedback into clear, evidence-based debrief summaries and candidate recommendations, with sound judgment about reviewing AI output for accuracy and bias before it informs a hiring decision.

5+ years of in-house or agency recruiting experience.
Demonstrated experience recruiting across a range of levels, from individual contributor through professional or exempt roles.
Experience recruiting for professional services, consulting, or other high-growth organization is a plus.
Prior contract or interim recruiting experience, comfortable ramping quickly on a new team's process and requisitions.
Experience with Predictive Index or a similar behavioral assessment tool.
Familiarity with competency-based, inclusive interviewing practices.
Additional Information
Work Location: Remote within the US or Canada.

At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.
Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.
Our Talent team is looking for an experienced and discerning technical recruiter to help build Linear’s next generation of engineering talent. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who sees recruiting as a craft.
Your primary focus will be growing our engineering team in North America. You’ll work closely with engineering leadership and our existing recruiters across product, infrastructure, AI, mobile, and emerging technical roles. You’ll own the full search, from mapping talent markets and activating networks through assessment, work trial support, and close.
Linear engineers tend to combine technical depth with product judgment, craftsmanship, and significant ownership. Finding them requires more than matching resumes to requirements.

We’re looking for someone who can recognize these qualities, reach candidates with precision, and continually sharpen their judgment through close partnership with our team. All recruiters at Linear are generalists and may support other functions as company priorities evolve, but engineering will be the primary focus of this role.
Location & work mode
Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North American (Eastern time zone), with a strong preference for the New York City area.

Being in New York enables closer partnership with our growing local team, candidate events, and optional in-person support during work trials. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

Partner directly with engineering leaders to understand their teams, develop hiring strategies, and own searches across product, infrastructure, AI, mobile, and other technical areas

Use funnel data, candidate feedback, and hiring outcomes to improve sourcing strategies and pre–work trial calibration
Maintain accurate, useful data in Ashby and ensure hiring partners have clear visibility into pipeline health, risks, and next steps
Contribute to how our small Talent team works, while remaining adaptable enough to support other functions as company needs evolve
